elaine: FYI a customer hit a validator hard reject: function hook returned a stringified JSON instead of an object. Need quick callout on telemetry + console UX.
raj: Classic. Which hook?
noah: search_v1. Example: `{"tool_response": "{\"result\": \"ok\"}"}` -> validator sees string vs object.
sanjay: We currently emit STRUCT_MISMATCH with no coercion context. Can we tag parseable vs non-parseable?
amanda: For console: show reason, attempted_coercion, trace_id, and a redacted preview. Two-step confirm to view raw.
elaine: Telemetry fields proposal: error_reason, attempted_coercion, coercion_strategy, display_hint. Trace artifacts should go to encrypted store (trace_id only in hot telemetry).
raj: Dashboard metric: validation_rejects_by_reason with hook_id label. Alert if spike >5x baseline in 10m.
noah: Short-term mitigation: if string parses to expected object, set attempted_coercion=true, accept and increment coercion_metric. Surface coerced flag in dashboards.
sanjay: ops-bot: create action for RFC+PRs?
ops-bot: Action created #5532130000 - RFC + telemetry PRs. Assignees: raj,noah,sanjay; due 2026-03-27.
elaine: I'll draft RFC and tie billing implications (ingress-only billing for validation rejects) into it.
raj: Will take validator patch.
noah: I'll do artifact wiring and ledger change PR.
amanda: I'll mock console rows and share later.
